content.text:
I fixed the crash with a one-line change in `packages/babel-generator/src/source-map.ts`. I haven't built Babel or run any tests, so the fix is unverified.

**Root cause:** When you pass an `inputSourceMap`, the generator copies the original source text from that map into the new one. It read `this._inputMap.sourcesContent[i]` without checking whether the field exists. Your input map has no `sourcesContent` (it's optional in the source map spec), so the field is `undefined` and indexing it throws `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading '0')`.

**Fix:**
```ts
this._inputMap.sourcesContent?.[i] || null,
```
When the input map has no `sourcesContent`, the generator now records `null` content for those sources instead of crashing. `null` is what `setSourceContent` in `@jridgewell/gen-mapping` takes to mean "no content".

On the WebdriverIO side, nothing needs to change in your setup. As a stopgap until a release includes this fix, you can add a `sourcesContent` array to the input source map.
